Activity master

Activity names and history: If you rename an activity, its new name will appear in all historical reports and previously saved entries. The activity's history is preserved, but its previous name will no longer be displayed.

Backup / restore

Export your settings and entries to a JSON file, or restore a backup. A backup is recommended before resetting data or changing devices.

Data-only CSV: Exports and imports daily activity statuses and journal notes without replacing your activity settings. The file uses activity IDs, so it can restore entries when activity IDs are preserved across app versions. A full JSON backup also includes the activity master and settings.

Reset app data

This will erase all daily entries and custom settings on this device. Habitude's original default activities and default appearance settings will be restored. This does not delete any backup already stored in Google Drive.

Google Drive sync

Habitude stores data locally and only accesses Google Drive when you explicitly connect and choose a sync action. No Google Sheets are used.

Not connected
Connect your Google account to back up or synchronize Habitude data.
Local-first: Your data remains on this device until you explicitly synchronize.
The Drive file is named habitude-sync.json. Sync now merges daily records by date and activity ID; when both copies contain the same key with different values, the local value is retained. Settings are merged by activity ID, with local activity settings taking precedence for matching IDs.

Habitude

A private, offline-first activity tracker for building routines, measuring consistency, and reflecting on progress.

What Habitude does

☑ Daily activity entryRecord completed, missed, or not recorded activities for each day.
▦ Visual progress trackerView day, week, month, year, or custom date ranges in a matrix.
↕ Flexible activity masterAdd, rename, reorder, deactivate, and manage activities without losing history.
⇩ Export and shareExport CSV or JSON and create a shareable tracker image.
◉ Offline-firstEntries and settings are stored in this browser and work without an internet connection.
☁ Optional Drive syncManually back up or synchronize JSON data through Google Drive. No Sheets integration.

Data and privacy

Your activity data is stored locally in your browser. It is not sent to a server by Habitude. Google Drive is contacted only when you choose to connect or synchronize. Browser storage can be removed by clearing browser data, so keep regular backups.
